children.text: Intercept is free and MIT-licensed. There is no paid tier, no trial, no account and no licence key.
No account, no telemetry and no paid tier. Every feature ships in the same build.
Camera, microphone, network and sign-in activity
Input protection with no time limit
Claude and Codex as trusted agents
Local history that is never trimmed
The MIT licence allows commercial use. Check Intercept against your organisation’s software policy before you roll it out.
No support contract or SLA during the preview
No managed deployment or central console
No. There is one build, and every feature is in it.
Can I use Intercept at work?
Yes. The MIT licence permits commercial use. There is no support contract during the preview.
Do I need an account or a licence key?
No. Intercept has no account, licence key or activation, and the app makes no outbound connections.
Read the documentation, or report a problem on GitHub. Report security issues privately, as the security brief describes.
